20.name: January 6, 2026
20.overview: TNA's Leon Slater challenges Oba Femi for the NXT Title. Jacy Jayne defends the NXT Women's Title against WWE Evolve Women's Champion Kendal Grey.

20.name: January 13, 2026
20.overview: Joe Hendry looks to settle the score with DarkState in a No Disqualification Match against Dion Lennox. Jasper Troy defends the Speed Title.

20.name: January 20, 2026
20.overview: Qualifying Matches begin for the NXT Championship Six-Man Ladder Match. Ethan Page defends the NXT North American Title against newcomer Elio LeFleur.

20.name: January 27, 2026
20.overview: OTM challenge DarkState for the NXT Tag Team Championship. Qualifying Matches continue for the NXT Title Six-Man Ladder Match.

20.name: February 3, 2026
20.overview: A new NXT Champion will rise from a Six-Man Ladder Match. Thea Hail, Lola Vice and Izzi Dame battle for the NXT Women's North American Title.

20.name: February 10, 2026
20.overview: Wren Sinclair & Kendal Grey challenge ZaRuca with a spot to become No. 1 Contender for the NXT Women's Title on the line.

20.name: February 17, 2026
20.overview: Ethan Page's quest for a new opponent leads to an NXT North American Title bout against Shiloh Hill. The Men's Speed Tournament reaches the finale.

20.name: February 24, 2026
20.overview: The NXT Universe prepare for seismic changes to the title picture when four championships are on the line on the same night.

20.name: March 3, 2026
20.overview: Jacy Jayne accepts Zaria's challenge for an NXT Women's Championship Match. Ricky Saints hosts "An Absolute Experience" as Vengeance Day draws near.

20.name: March 10, 2026
20.overview: NXT Superstars react to the fallout from NXT Vengeance Day. Jasper Troy, Eli Knight and Sean Legacy clash in a Triple Threat Match.

20.name: March 17, 2026
20.overview: Houston hosts Booker T Appreciation Night. Jacy Jayne defends the NXT Women's Title against Sol Ruca and Zaria in a Triple Threat Match.

20.name: March 24, 2026
20.overview: NXT Superstars endure a Gauntlet Eliminator to become the No. 1 Contender to the NXT North American Title. Tony D'Angelo takes on Ricky Saints.

20.name: March 31, 2026
20.overview: NXT Champion Joe Hendry, Ethan Page, Ricky Saints and Tony D'Angelo sign the contract for their Fatal 4-Way Match for the title at Stand & Deliver.

20.name: April 7, 2026
20.overview: Keanu Carver gets the Triple Threat Match he demanded against Jasper Troy and Josh Briggs. A new Men's Speed Tournament begins for the vacant title.

20.name: April 14, 2026
20.overview: With payback on his mind, Tony D'Angelo defends the NXT Title against Ethan Page. Joe Hendry addresses his NXT future in a concert.

20.name: April 21, 2026
20.overview: Sol Ruca and Zaria clash in a Last Woman Standing Match. Tatum Paxley aims to end Blake Monroe's claims of championship legitimacy in a Casket Match.

20.name: April 28, 2026
20.overview: Ricky Saints demands to be taken seriously in a match against Shiloh Hill. "The Rocker" Lizzy Rain steps into the spotlight in her NXT debut.

20.name: May 5, 2026
20.overview: Kali Armstrong steps up to Jaida Parker to prove who's the baddest in NXT. Jasper Troy looks to take out Jackson Drake.

20.name: May 12, 2026
20.overview: The ominous Naraku makes his in-ring debut. Kendal Grey aims to get payback for Wren Sinclair by going against Kelani Jordan. Noam Dar returns.

20.name: May 19, 2026
20.overview: Tatum Paxley grants Lizzy Rain an opportunity to fight for the NXT Women's North American Title. DarkState get an NXT Tag Team Title rematch.

20.name: May 26, 2026
20.overview: Lola Vice brings the heat to Izzi Dame in an NXT Women's Title Match. A new Men's Speed Tournament begins with Sean Legacy battling Dorian Van Dux.

20.name: June 2, 2026
20.overview: Tony D'Angelo looks to teach a lesson to an overconfident Kam Hendrix in their NXT Title Match. Lizzy Rain tries to halt Zaria's path of destruction.

20.name: June 9, 2026
20.overview: Tatum Paxley puts the NXT Women's North American Title on the line against a rampaging Zaria. Tristan Angels and Shiloh Hill aim to become Mr. NXT.

20.name: June 16, 2026
20.overview: Tony D'Angelo and Naraku come face to face before their epic battle at Great American Bash. A new Women's Speed Tournament begins.

20.name: June 23, 2026
20.overview: Two major contract signings set the stage for NXT Great American Bash. Aaron Rourke defends the Evolve Championship versus the upstart Tristan Angels.

20.name: June 30, 2026
20.overview: NXT and AAA clash in two epic inter-promotional title fights with NXT's Vanity Project and AAA's El Hijo del Vikingo putting the titles on the line.

20.name: July 7, 2026
20.overview: Two major Fatal 4-Way Matches determine No. 1 Contenders to NXT Titles. Kendal Grey begins her NXT Women's Title reign against Nattie.

20.name: July 14, 2026
20.overview: Layla Diggs looks to shock the world by challenging Zaria for the NXT Women's North American Championship.

20.name: July 21, 2026
20.overview: In his quest for payback against Naraku, Tony D'Angelo defends the NXT Title against his nemesis in a Street Fight. Nattie battles Jaida Parker.

20.name: July 28, 2026
20.overview: Myles Borne puts the NXT North American Championship at stake against Kam Hendrix in hopes of securing a future NXT Tag Team Title fight.

20.name: August 4, 2026
20.overview: Kendal Grey puts the NXT Women's Title on the line as she accepts Lola Vice's challenge to square off in the merciless NXT Underground.

20.name: August 11, 2026
20.overview: Cruz Montana goes one-on-one with newfound rival Grayson Waller for the opportunity to become the No. 1 Contender to the NXT Championship.

20.name: August 18, 2026
20.overview: Recent tensions put WrenQCC on a collision course with Kali Armstrong & Kelani Jordan. Four competitors vie for an AAA Cruiserweight Title opportunity.

20.name: August 25, 2026
20.overview: Saquon Shugars goes to war with former DarkState ally Dion Lennox in a Weaponized Steel Cage Match. Rey Fenix faces EK Prosper in an AAA title fight.

20.name: September 1, 2026
20.overview: The fallout from Heatwave 2026 ripples through the locker room. Shiloh Hill enters the ring seeking payback against Naraku.

20.name: September 8, 2026
20.overview: A Six-Man Tag Team Match narrows the list of potential NXT Title contenders. Jaida Parker challenges new NXT Women's Champion Kelani Jordan.

20.name: September 15, 2026
20.overview: A Triple Threat Match determines the No. 1 Contender to the NXT Championship. Myles Borne issues a public apology to Tavion Heights.

20.name: September 22, 2026
20.overview: Thea Hail teams with AAA's La Catalina to take on two NXT champions, Kelani Jordan & Zaria. The Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic begins.

20.name: September 29, 2026
20.overview: Mason Rook was not medically cleared to wrestle but Grayson Waller was still made to put the NXT Championship on the line in an open challenge. Thea Hail zeroes in on Zaria and a second title reign.

20.name: October 6, 2026
20.overview: An opportunity to become the No. 1 Contender to the NXT Women's Championship awaits as 20 Superstars collide in a Battle Royal.

20.name: October 13, 2026
20.overview: Tony D'Angelo and Myles Borne clash for the right to challenge NXT Champion Grayson Waller at Halloween Havoc. The Dusty Classic Quarterfinals begin.

20.name: October 20, 2026
20.overview: Cruz Montana seeks payback against Dion Lennox following a backstage beatdown. The Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic Quarterfinals continue.

20.name: October 27, 2026
20.overview: Jackson Drake's NXT North American Title reign is on the line against EK Prosper. Saquon Shugars squares off with Sean Legacy.

overview: Wrestlers will portray heroes or villains as they follow a series of events that build tension and culminate in a wrestling match or series of matches.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: It's the dawning of a new era in NXT as the gold and black brand finds a home at Full Sail University, crowns its first champion, and kicks off the WWE careers of Seth Rollins, Cesaro, Roman Reigns, and more.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: Witness a tournament to crown the first NXT Tag Team and Women's Champions, the Shield rise in dominance, and the debuts of Sasha Banks, Sami Zayn, and more future WWE Superstars during 2013 in NXT.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: The future is now as NXT makes its mark with its first live specials taking over WWE Network. Paige, Kevin Owens, Rusev & Lana, Charlotte Flair, and more up-and-coming WWE Superstars highlight 2014 in NXT.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: Finn Bálor, Bayley, Samoa Joe, Becky Lynch, and more future WWE Superstars make 2015 one of the most historic years in NXT. Featuring the first NXT TakeOver: Brooklyn and inaugural Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: Strong style takes over NXT in 2016 as Shinsuke Nakamura joins the brand and Asuka's undefeated streak carries her to the NXT Women's Championship. Featuring Bayley, Samoa Joe, No Way Jose, Finn Bálor, and more

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: Chaos reigns supreme in NXT during 2017 as the Undisputed Era makes its mark, SAnitY runs amok, Ember Moon succeeds Asuka, Bobby Roode is glorious, the United Kingdom Championship debuts, and so much more.

seasons.name: Season 12
seasons.overview: Darkness falls over NXT in 2018 as Aleister Black, Tommaso Ciampa, Shayna Baszler, and War Raiders loom over the brand. Plus, Velveteen Dream, Johnny Gargano, Ricochet, and more help take NXT to the next level.

seasons.name: Season 13
seasons.overview: The future is now! In 2019 on NXT heated rivalries like Johnny Gargano vs. Adam Cole take center stage while the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic Tournament returns. All this and much more action.

tagline: WWE NXT features the next generation of Superstars battling to make an impact.
